comments.quote: 在壹家墅的這三天，像住進了一幅會呼吸的山景畫裏。晨起推開陽台門，雲霧在腳下流淌，暮色時分，整座山谷被染成金紅色——光是坐在露台上發呆，都覺得時間慢得奢侈，這三天晚上睡得特別安靜，舒適。 最驚喜的是廚房設施一應俱全，去山下菜場買了新鮮菜，自己動手做早飯，煙火氣裏竟有了幾分“家”的味道。管家把細節打點得妥帖，有求必應卻又安靜得恰到好處。 必須誇誇司機胡師傅——我們每晚玩到很晚才返程，他永遠笑呵呵地等我們，山路開得穩當又温柔，還貼心備了多床被子，非常和藹，不愧是一名優秀退伍老兵。 臨走時竟有些捨不得，這三天不衹是度假，更像被山水和人情味好好款待了一場。若你也想尋一處清靜卻不冷清的山居時光，來壹家墅吧，這裏值得住進心裏。
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: Three days here were like living inside a landscape painting that breathes. Push the balcony door open in the morning and the cloud is running below you. At dusk the whole valley turns gold and red. Sitting on the terrace doing nothing, time felt luxuriously slow. I slept quietly and well all three nights. The best surprise was the kitchen, which has everything, so we bought vegetables at the market down the hill and cooked our own breakfast, and the cooking smells gave the place something of a home. The manager handles the details properly, there whenever you need anything and otherwise exactly as unobtrusive as you want. Hu, the driver, deserves a mention. We were out late every night and he was always waiting with a smile, steady and gentle on the mountain roads, and he had put extra quilts in the car. A kind man and clearly a good soldier once. I did not want to leave. Those three days were less a holiday than a piece of proper hospitality from the landscape and the people both. If you want somewhere quiet without being lonely, come here.

comments.quote: 這次的選擇絕對超預期。 硬軟件設施和周圍環境不亞於裸心谷，但性價比超好。更有貼心的一對一管家服務（細緻周到，及時回覆），七座商務接駁車（胡師傅不管多忙都耐心熱情、滿臉笑意，還應我們的要求推薦他蒐集住客反饋的各類美食餐廳），每天屋內阿姨們的徹底打掃…暖暖的很貼心
